Execution order: Markdown step 9 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 32 (Markdown 08/12 — Add desktop document commands, navigation and references). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Implement the editable design document panel by reusing the existing EasyMDE MarkdownEditor/VersionedMarkdownEditor in src/main.tsx. Extract reusable code only as needed; do not add another editor library.
Scope:
- Provide title editing, Markdown formatting toolbar, Preview, complete body editing, architecture/document associations and create/save/delete controls consistent with existing UI.
- Adapt versioned drafts to canonical document readTokens. Capture the token corresponding to the body the user edited; never substitute a fresh token on an old draft.
- Show saving/saved/error/conflict states. On concurrent changes keep the draft and present explicit reload/reconciliation; failed saves, polling, navigation, project changes and backend migration must not silently discard content.
- Audit current blur/unmount commit behavior so reload/discard/delete/navigation cannot autosave stale or discarded text or resurrect deleted documents. Ensure clean external refresh does not create edits.
- Keep generated agent headers out of canonical content. Preserve Markdown code fences, links and Unicode; reuse/apply safe preview and link handling, accessible keyboard operation and usable resizing.
Acceptance:
- Native Tauri/WebView2 tests create/edit/preview/reopen documents on SQLite and text, format through the actual existing toolbar, and open the panel from task/QA references.
- Exercise MCP-versus-desktop conflicting writes, failed saves, explicit reload/discard, navigation/unmount, deletion and backend change with a dirty draft.
- Verify saved content through MCP and generated files, not only UI-local state or mocked tests.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.

data.title: Markdown 09/12 — Reuse the existing editable Markdown panel with guarded drafts
